records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically its second and third quarter financial results have reflected higher travel demand, and were better than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the six months ended June 30, 2023 and 2022, the Company recognized approximately $4.6 billion and $2.6 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales of the 2021 ATM Shares under the Distribution Agreement were allowed to be made in any transactions that were deemed to be "at the market offerings" as defined in Rule 415 under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During 2021, approximately 4 million shares were sold in the 2021 ATM Offering at an average price of $57.50 per share, with net proceeds to the Company totaling approximately $250 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: CommuteAir currently operates 56 regional aircraft under a capacity purchase agreement ("CPA") that has a term through 2026.
